about: Blind runs of the sdp-semantic-review skill on the six Theme A packets in theme-a/v1. Each run read the skill's documents and its six packets only, never the oracles, a fixture's recorded answer or another run, and wrote its answers with the metasalmon-skill adapter's write_assessments action, which calls no package function. `replay_theme_a.py cohort` ingests every answer through the pinned package and scores it on the oracles. Brett promotes a run by setting its promoted_by.
